title: Commit Credit Escrow and Deferred Slate Playbook
creator: Priya Desai
description: Problem: mid-cycle over-commit and last-minute scope churn cause cross-team friction and repeated rushes on engineering resources. Goal: design and pilot a lightweight 'Commit Credit' escrow system (ledger + rules + UI) that lets squads reserve commit capacity, trade credits across teams via a simple marketplace, and defer lower-priority work into a formal deferred slate without breaking OKR alignment. We expect smoother throughput, clearer scope visibility, and fewer emergency surges. This ticket defines the playbook, initial rules, telemetry, and rollout plan for a 6-week pilot with 6 squads.
objectives: Reduce mid-cycle high-priority scope additions that trigger >24h all-hands by 30% in pilot squads
Decrease number of reactive surge tickets routed to shared infra by 40%
Validate operational workflow for cross-team credit swaps and measure swap latency and approvals
Produce an actionable playbook and automated ledger prototype for cycle adoption
out_of_scope: Full integration with payroll or financial accounting
Enforcing credits as hard blockers in CI/CD pipelines
Company-wide rollout without a pilot validation phase
decision_log: 2026-03-02 - Priya: proposed soft-credit model where teams earn credits from historical on-time delivery and reserve credits to 'reserve' scope for a cycle. Agreed to pilot soft-enforcement (operational signal) vs hard-block.
2026-03-05 - Jordan: recommended a 2-tier marketplace: immediate swaps (manager-approved) and scheduled swaps (cross-squad coordinator). Product will ship UI for schedule view first.
2026-03-08 - Engineering feedback (Luca Moreno): require a single API to query available credits and optimistic locking to avoid double-reserves. Added ENG-1842 as dependency for API contract.
2026-03-10 - PM review (Maya Chen): acceptance criteria must include explicit metrics and dashboard views; agreed to add 'swap latency' and 'deferred slate burn-down' metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype ledger service deployed to staging with REST endpoints: GET /credits, POST /reserve, POST /swap
UI mockups for commit ledger and deferred slate accepted by design and PM
Pilot plan documented in Confluence with squad sign-ups and guardrails
Dashboards surfaced in Console showing credits balance, pending reserves, swap queue, and deferred slate burn-down
Observability: alerts for >10% failed reservations and >48h pending swap approvals
implementation_notes: Ledger will be implemented as a lightweight service backed by a Postgres table with optimistic concurrency control
Auth: integrate Redwood SSO group checks for manager approvals; use existing RBAC hooks from ENG-824613
Temporary UI: a single-page app under /cycle-tools with reserve and swap flows; minimal UX to reduce friction
Telemetry: instrument events for reserve.created, reserve.fulfilled, swap.requested, swap.completed, deferred.added, deferred.completed
Rollout: 6-week pilot, weekly syncs, triage slot on Tuesday PM cadence
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: teams hoard credits and avoid cooperation -> Mitigation: introduce small recurring credit expiry and visible hall-of-fame for cooperative swaps
Risk: perceived bureaucracy -> Mitigation: soft-enforcement and ability to fast-track with manager sign-off limited to 3 expedited swaps per squad per cycle
Risk: skewed credit allocation disadvantaging new squads -> Mitigation: initial allocation includes base credits for all squads and a small onboarding bonus
metrics_and_success: Primary metric: reduction in last-minute surge tickets triaged as 'emergency' (baseline and pilot comparison)
Operational metrics: average swap approval time, number of credits traded, deferred slate size at cycle end
Qualitative: squad survey on perceived predictability (pre/post pilot)
